headline: Sleep Tracker, from entry to detail
overview: Log hours slept, quality rating, wake feeling, and disturbances to build a complete picture of your sleep health over time.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Sleep Tracker — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the sleep log form with hours slept, quality rating, wake feeling, and disturbances fields.
steps.screenshotAlt: Sleep Tracker landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Log total hours slept each night
Rate sleep quality and how you feel upon waking
Track sleep trends and patterns over weeks
tips: Log your sleep each morning while your memory of the night is still fresh.
Note specific disturbances (stress, noise, screen time) to identify what most impacts your sleep.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
